subject.title: [Bug]: Read-only operators trigger forbidden approval requests on every Control UI connection

question: Should the Control UI adopt the reported scope-aware approval bootstrap guard, including the proposed legacy-connection compatibility behavior?
rationale: The reported defect is narrow, but preserving legacy connections alongside administrator and explicitly authorized reviewer behavior is an authorization-compatibility decision that should be confirmed by the protected maintainer workflow.

options.title: Approve scoped bootstrap guard
options.body: Align UI approval requests with the Gateway's authoritative approval scope while covering all stated operator and legacy connection modes.

options.title: Keep legacy bootstrap behavior
options.body: Retain unconditional bootstrap only if maintainers confirm that legacy clients require it and define a safer error-suppression or capability-negotiation path.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped bootstrap guard
recommendation.body: Align UI approval requests with the Gateway's authoritative approval scope while covering all stated operator and legacy connection modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The report contains the only available concrete trace of the affected Control UI and Gateway contract boundary.
